yoast.seo_title: Monument Signs Jacksonville, FL | Brand 9 Signs
yoast.meta_description: Custom monument signs in Jacksonville & NE Florida — commercial & community entrance monuments, designed, permitted & installed by one team since 1986.

faqs: How much does a monument sign cost in Jacksonville?

Most monument signs in the Jacksonville area cost $8,000–$35,000+ installed. A typical masonry monument with dimensional lettering runs about $12,000–$20,000; size, materials, lighting, and permitting drive the final price.
How long does it take to get a monument sign?

Plan on about 8–12 weeks from approval — covering HOA/architectural review, county permitting and Florida wind-load engineering, fabrication, and installation. For a new community, order the day you break ground.
Do I need a permit for a monument sign in Jacksonville?
Yes. Duval, Clay, and St. Johns counties each have their own sign codes, and Florida requires wind-load engineering. Brand 9 Signs handles the permit and engineering as part of the project.
Do you build monument signs for national homebuilders?

Yes. Alongside our local Northeast Florida work, we produce monument and community entrance signage for homebuilders and developers across Florida and nationally, coordinated to their construction timelines.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — monuments can be ground-lit, halo-lit, or built with internally illuminated push-through letters so your entrance is visible after dark. Lighting adds electrical work but greatly increases nighttime impact.
